newsitem.title: USA: CitFed OKs stock split, sets dividend.
newsitem.headline: CitFed OKs stock split, sets dividend.

text.p: CitFed Bancorp Inc said on Friday it has approved a three-for-two stock split in the form of a stock dividend to be paid November 29 to stockholders of record on November 15.
The stock dividend will pay one common share of CitFed Bancorp for every two shares of common stock held on the record date.

The company also set its regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share on the post-split shares. The regular quarterly cash dividend is to be paid December 2 to stockholders of record on November 15.
Stockholders will receive cash in lieu of fractional shares.
CitFed also said it expects to take a one-time, pre-tax charge of about $10.4 million in the second quarter ended September 30 for its part in recapitalizing the Savings Association Insurance Fund.
Its second quarter earnings are to be announced on October 29.
